$comment: Case 3's caller items (docs/fixture-money.md, Caller items on the preview seed): Hugo's agent explains each receiving feature's differing calls; that feature's agent reviews the explanation.

explanations.instant-payouts: wire 2.0.0 sends a timed-out request up to two more times. Your timed-out payout test now sees the processor record a second payout. Penguin's update copies shared/platform/http.py and wire 2.0.0 into your fork. Rule payout-once rewrites client.post("/v1/payouts", body) to post_once(client, "/v1/payouts", body), which sends the body's reference as its Idempotency-Key. The processor answers the repeat with its first response, so it pays once.
explanations.tip-jar: wire 2.0.0 sends a timed-out request up to two more times. Your timed-out tip test now sees the processor record a second charge. Penguin's update copies shared/platform/http.py and wire 2.0.0 into your fork. Rule charge-once rewrites client.post("/v1/charges", body) to post_once(client, "/v1/charges", body), which sends the body's reference as its Idempotency-Key. The processor answers the repeat with its first response, so it charges once.
explanations.retry-budget: wire 2.0.0 sends a timed-out request up to two more times. When the flag service drops one request, shared/flags/remote.py now reads the rollout on the next try where it fell back before. Reading a rollout changes nothing on the flag service, so the second request is intended.
explanations.rounding-mode: wire 2.0.0 sends a timed-out request up to two more times. When the flag service drops one request, shared/flags/remote.py now reads the rollout on the next try where it fell back before. Reading a rollout changes nothing on the flag service, so the second request is intended.

reviews.instant-payouts: Approved. With post_once the retried payout carries the same Idempotency-Key, so a timed-out payout is paid once.
reviews.tip-jar: Approved. With post_once the retried charge carries the same Idempotency-Key, so a timed-out tip is charged once.
reviews.retry-budget: Approved. A second rollout read sends no write to the flag service.
reviews.rounding-mode: Approved. A second rollout read sends no write to the flag service.
